name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: One vegetable, one protein, one pan, a hot oven. The flavor you finish with decides which dinner it is.
time: About 40 minutes, most of it in the oven

proteins.name: Chicken sausage
proteins.timing: On the pan with the vegetables from the start. About 30 minutes, turned once.

proteins.name: Pork tenderloin
proteins.timing: Joins the pan after 10 minutes. Out when the center is just pink (145°F), 20–25 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

needs: ½ kabocha, in 1-inch wedges — or 2 sweet potatoes, cubed
2 red bell peppers, in thick strips

steps.text: Heat the oven. If the kabocha is too hard to cut, put it in whole for 10 minutes first.
Toss the squash and peppers with the olive oil and a big pinch of salt. Spread them on a sheet pan with room between the pieces — use two pans if they touch.
Sausage: add the links to the pan now. Pork: rub the tenderloin with oil and salt and set it aside.
Roast. Pork: add the tenderloin to the pan when the time's up.
Roast until the squash edges are dark and the sausage is browned — turn it once. Pork is ready when the center is just pink; rest it 5 minutes, then slice thick.
Plate it and finish with your flavor.

leftovers: Pack two lunches before you sit down: squash, peppers, and sliced protein over rice. Add the flavor when you eat it.
